;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019–20 Lebanese protests]]
**The [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese Army]] clashes with supporters of [[Hezbollah]] and [[Amal Movement]] in [[Beirut]]. The [[Shia Islam|Shiite]] [[Islamism|Islamists]] were attempting to attack an anti-[[Government of Lebanon|government]] protester camp in [[Martyrs' Square, Beirut|Martyrs' Square]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-lebanon-protests-clashes/lebanese-army-clashes-with-supporters-of-hezbollah-amal-in-beirut-idUKKBN1YK27F?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]]
**[[Boeing]] decides to halt production of the faulty [[Boeing 737 MAX]]. [https://www.economist.com/leaders/2019/12/17/boeings-misplaced-strategy (''The Economist'')]

;Law and crime
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] refuses to hear a case regarding [[homelessness in the United States|homeless]] people sleeping in public parks, and on sidewalks, when no other shelter is available. In allowing the camping, the high court left intact a lower court ruling, calling such bans [[cruel and unusual punishment]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/12/16/homeless-supreme-court-living-street-crime/4403793002/ (''USA Today'')]
*In rare protests, dozens are arrested in [[Kazakhstan]] during [[Independence Day (Kazakhstan)|Independence Day]]. Protestors demand political reform and the sidelining of the family of former [[President of Kazakhstan|President]] [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kazakhstan-independence-protests/dozens-detained-in-rare-kazakhstan-independence-day-protests-idUSKBN1YK1B1?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Cannabis in Zambia]]
**[[Zambia]] legalizes the production and export of [[cannabis (drug)|cannabis]] for economic and medicinal purposes, but recreational use of the drug remains illegal. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zambia-cannabis/zambia-approves-cannabis-exports-to-boost-economy-idUSKBN1YK1XU (Reuters)]
*The [[Human rights defender|human rights group]] International Rights Advocates formally launches a lawsuit in the [[United States]] against [[Apple Inc.]], [[Alphabet Inc.]] ([[Google]]), [[Tesla, Inc.]], [[Dell]] and [[Microsoft]] on behalf of 14 [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] families whose children died or were injured in [[Copperbelt]] mines that supply [[cobalt]] for the firms' [[lithium-ion battery]] products. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-50812616 (BBC News)]
*Wanted [[Moroccan-Dutch]] criminal [[Ridouan Taghi]] has been arrested in [[Dubai]]. He was wanted by the [[Netherlands]] for large scale [[cocaine]] [[drug trafficking|trafficking]] and multiple [[murder]]s. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/16/dubai-police-arrest-most-wanted-man-netherlands-ridouan-taghi (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
** The [[United States House Committee on the Judiciary|U.S. House Judiciary Committee]] releases its 658-page report on its inquiry of the [[impeachment in the United States|impeachment]] of [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]], claiming he committed [[Contempt of Congress|obstruction of Congress]] and [[abuse of power]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/12/16/politics/house-judiciary-committee-impeachment-charges-report/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 French pension reform strike]]
**On the twelfth day of the strike, [[Jean-Paul Delevoye]] resigns. Delevoye, who was in charge of the proposed pension reform, failed to disclose private posts and income in his [[Financial disclosure of public servants|asset declaration]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/16/france-pensions-chief-jean-paul-delevoye-resigns-as-transport-strike-enters-12th-day (''The Guardian'')] 

;Science and technology
*[[SpaceX]] successfully launches the [[JCSAT-18]] and [[Kacific Broadband Satellites|Kacific 1]] [[communications satellite]]s on a [[Falcon 9 Block 5]] rocket from [[Cape Canaveral Air Force Station]]. The satellites will bring [[Internet]] access to isolated islands in the [[Pacific Ocean]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/16/tech/spacex-launch-kacific-jcsat-scn/index.html (CNN)]
